text: I never said it. She worked it out.
style: ENTROPY's planner, a man in his sixties, in person at his own console. Deliberately unplaceable -- an educated, faintly mid-Atlantic English with every regional marker sanded off, which could be Western European or North American; keep it consistent throughout. Low pitch that never lifts; quiet, slow, deliberate pace with a lecturer's precision. Faintly amused and courteous to the end. Nothing that happens tonight surprises him, including losing.
